pageTitle: Idaho Lottery Results and Winning Numbers

items.question: What Do I Do If I Win?
items.answer: If you see the results of the Idaho Lottery and realize that you’re a winner, you may claim your prize winnings. If it’s under $600, you can visit any authorized retailer. For $600+, you’ll need to complete a claim form and addendum. You can mail these documents to the Idaho Lottery offices with the original ticket and proof of ID.

items.question: How Does the Idaho Lottery Second Chance Work?
items.answer:
There’s an excellent feature that allows players with non-winning tickets to enter the Idaho Lottery Second Chance promotions. Here, you use any cards that aren’t winners to have another opportunity to win a prize pot.

 

Players have 180 days to claim their prize; otherwise, it’s a forfeit.

items.question: What Was the idaho Lottery Highest Payout?
items.answer: In 2005 Brad Duke won $220 million on an Idaho Lottery Powerball PowerPlay jackpot.
